text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I will, I will!
I will, I will, I will become one!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"At this Arima Kinen, I'll be the most sparkling Umamusume.
A strong Umamusume who won't be depressed thinking 'someone like me'!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, today feels...
completely different from before...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is so strong and in amazing shape.
Opera O-san, Special Week-san, Grass Wonder-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready to run myself ragged, too!
But... can I really win?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san is the toughest of all. No matter how
boxed in she gets, she has the Overlord power to break through.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder-san has incredible focus,
and Special Week-san has an incredible late charge...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Then what is it that only I have?
No matter how hard I search, I just can't find it."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm so useless, totally hopeless... That's why I feel like I always have to do something and just give it my all~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't have anything to boast about.
Nothing that's uniquely mine, nowhere!
And yet...!
choice_data_list: That lack of confidence is your real strength.
That lack of confidence is your real strength.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, my lack of confidence is... my strength?
My... flaws are?"

I nodded quietly. It was precisely because of my lack
of confidence that I've always worked so hard to dispel my anxiety.
Refusing to give up, she never stopped pushing herself—and at last, climbed all the way to this grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I hadn't even thought of that... But everyone else
hasn't been in such a hectic rush, have they...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Still, no matter how much I practiced, it was never enough.
So I practiced, practiced, and practiced!
Practiced over and over and over, until I made it here!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I don't have any confidence today either...
That's why I can't let my guard down, not even for a second..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Until the very, very end, across the goal!
Until I know for sure I crossed it first!
That's why—!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Trainer, I had one too!
A treasure that belongs only to me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
With this, I'll surpass Opera O-san and those two seniors!
And I'll definitely shine bright!!
